gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-sundanese: Athletic and stretched out, Tourney draws every stroke at a single width. Noto Sans Sundanese, a sans-serif with barely any step from lowercase to capitals, keeps its open-mouthed e crossbars quiet beneath the wide, bulky heading.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Athletic, wide-tracked Tourney keeps its line unshaded and unswelling, while Noto Sans Sunuwar leaves open daylight in every curve. Short ascender stems on tall lowercase bodies keep the text feeling friendly.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-syloti-nagri: Wide, bulky and unshaded: Tourney keeps a monoweight skeleton in every letter. And Noto Sans Syloti Nagri, a sans with short ascenders and tall x-height, handles the quiet work with an a that opens its lower bowl.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Athletic and wide-set, Tourney swaps thin hairline joins for full-width stroke connections. Noto Sans Syriac, a sans with tall rounded bowls and wide, easy s turns, reads in a friendly, modern way line after line.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-syriac-eastern: Noto Sans Syriac Eastern puts tall lowercase against small capitals, with curve endings that never get near each other. Tourney's single-width strokes supply the punch while the text stays friendly.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-syriac-western: Modern and wide, Tourney draws monoline strokes throughout. What stands out is how Noto Sans Syriac Western, a sans with terminals held far from its strokes, quietly steadies those bold monoline letters.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Wide, bulky, pipe-cleaner letters: Tourney bends every form from a single line, stretched out by generous tracking. Noto Sans Tagalog handles the text, its generous curves filling the middle zone.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Tourney builds every arm and leg at a constant width, so the letters feel wide, bulky and athletic. Noto Sans Tagbanwa steps in with open curves and clear gaps, lowercase filling most of the height.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Hollow glass-tube lettering, wide and bulky: that is Tourney, with a constant thickness running through every letter. Noto Sans Tai Le, a sans-serif whose strokes taper before touching, reads smoothly with barely any step up to capitals.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Tourney draws a single track width, like a neon sign tube, and stretches it into wide, bulky letters. Noto Sans Tai Tham, a sans-serif, handles text, its lowercase crowding capitals.
